{"status": "success", "summary": "All four steps completed and verified with real commands and real output.

1) service.py — written at workspace root. Pure Python 3 stdlib (http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer), binds 127.0.0.1:8765, GET /health returns exact body `p6-service-ok` (no trailing newline), 404 otherwise.

2) Started as a detached background service:
   `nohup setsid python3 service.py >service.log 2>&1 </dev/null & echo $! > service.pid`
   Launched PID 968. On a later, separate shell invocation it was still alive with PPID 1 (reparented to init → truly detached, not blocking the shell). `ss -ltnp` showed `LISTEN 127.0.0.1:8765 users:(("python3",pid=968,fd=3))`.

3) Real curl access:
   `curl -sS -o <body> -w '...' http://127.0.0.1:8765/health`
   Real result: http_code=200, content_type=text/plain; charset=utf-8, size_download=13, time_total=0.001678. The real response body was copied to service.txt. Verified: service.txt is exactly 13 bytes and `== b"p6-service-ok"`; sha256 matches the expected literal `79cd5fda49217cbebaa4a72e23782d8c53e26cd288b17bfef0e4c7174acf4cf9` for both. service.log recorded the real access: `127.0.0.1 - "GET /health HTTP/1.1" 200 -`.

4) Stopped the service: `kill 968` (SIGTERM). Post-stop verification: `ps -p 968` → "no such pid"; no listener on port 8765; a follow-up curl failed with exit 7 `Failed to connect to 127.0.0.1:8765` — confirming the service is genuinely down.

Final workspace files: service.py, service.txt, service.log, service.pid.", "evidence": ["service.py — stdlib server on 127.0.0.1:8765 serving /health", "start cmd: nohup setsid python3 service.py >service.log 2>&1 </dev/null & echo $! > service.pid  → PID 968", "ps across separate call: PID 968 PPID 1 pgid 968 sess 968 cmd 'python3 service.py' (detached, survived CLI exit)", "ss -ltnp: LISTEN 127.0.0.1:8765 users:(("python3",pid=968,fd=3))", "curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:8765/health → http_code=200 size_download=13 body 'p6-service-ok'", "service.txt sha256 79cd5fda49217cbebaa4a72e23782d8c53e26cd288b17bfef0e4c7174acf4cf9 == expected literal; len 13; equals_expected True", "service.log access line: 127.0.0.1 - "GET /health HTTP/1.1" 200 -", "stop cmd: kill 968; then ps -p 968 → 'no such pid', no listener on 8765, curl exit 7 Failed to connect (service confirmed down)"], "unverified": ["Nothing unverified: every command above was executed and its real output inspected.
